note: Land unit sizes used by BhumiSathi. Decimal (শতক) is the base: 1 decimal = 1/100 acre = 435.6 sq ft. Regional units (kani, bigha) differ by area: the app always shows which size it used. Confirm local sizes with the AC Land office / DLRS before any transaction.

katha.source: Bangladesh standard 1 katha = 720 sq ft (Banglapedia; widely used)

bigha.source: Standard 1 bigha = 20 katha = 14,400 sq ft ≈ 33.06 decimals; local bighas differ — enter your local size if it is different.

kani_family.relations_source: 1 kani = 20 gonda, 1 gonda = 4 kora (Banglapedia, Agrometrology); 1 kora = 3 kranti (commonly used, confirm locally).

sizes.where_bn: যেমন নোয়াখালী অঞ্চলে প্রচলিত; কুমিল্লায়ও ব্যবহৃত
sizes.source: Banglapedia (Agrometrology): 1 kani = 120 decimal; Legalseba: Noakhali kani typically 120 decimal
Banglapedia lists a 40-decimal kani as a regional variant; ministry unit page gives both 40 and 120 (project research)
Legalseba: in Comilla a kani can mean 120 or 30 decimal

sources.title: Legalseba — Land Measurement Systems in Bangladesh
